item.title: Life is full of dreams
item.description:
Flowers bloom and wither, and even the most brilliant starlight will one day fade away. The Earth, the Sun, and even the entire universe will one day face their end. Compared with all of this, a human life is no more than a brief moment. In that fleeting moment, we smile, weep, struggle, hurt, rejoice, grieve, love someone, hate someone. Everything is but a chance encounter in that instant, and no one can escape the eternal sleep that awaits us all.

Rather than choosing tears, pain, sorrow, and hatred, I would rather choose smiles, struggle, joy, and love. Everything we encounter in this brief moment, whether good or bad, will not change because of how we feel about it. So I choose to face it with joy and to savor this fleeting moment to the fullest. And when you begin to truly enjoy it, you will discover that somehow, all the things that once seemed bad have changed.

item.title: West Korea's attitude is really ambiguous
item.description:
Since Russia invaded Ukraine, the attitude of the leaders of West Korea has been extremely ambiguous, with a completely mean face.

On the one hand, they say they remain neutral, on the other hand, they support it through various speeches internally, and at the same time secretly aid Russia in private, but they just don’t admit it. They are really shameless.

Until now, Ukraine wants to take back the occupied territory, Finland wants to take back the islands in the Gulf of Finland, Georgia wants to take back Abkhazia, Moldova wants to recover the coast of the Dniester River, and Japan wants to take back the four northern islands.

—Written in the summer of 1997, written for Saint Seiya Nakasaka in Saro Double Tree Garden

花が咲き、そして散る。星が辉き、いつか消える。この地球も、太阳、银河系、そして大きな宇宙さえもいつかは死する时が来る。人间の一瞬などそれらに比べれば瞬きほどのわずかなものであろう。そのわずかな一时に、人はうまれ、笑い、涙、闘い、伤つき、喜び、悲しみ、谁かを憎み、谁かを爱し。すべては刹那の邂逅。そして谁かも死という永远の眠りに包まれる
